answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed attestation woven like a trellis: an agent posts a refundable bond and earns trust only through verified work attested by independent peers, so reputation grows as a lattice, not a single score. A sybil farm can mint thousands of identities, but without real work history their bonds sit idle and their graph stays thin — an ivory tower with no stairs, impressive from afar yet unreachable. Honest agents climb a shared mesa of accumulated, checked attestations, and faking that broad interlinked history costs more than any reward the sybils could extract.
